Ticket #09 — Appointment Rescheduling

Difficulty: Medium

Context

You maintain a clinic's appointment tool. Each string time slot can hold one appointment. A patient may reschedule only their own appointment; a failed move must preserve the original booking so the patient still has a confirmed time.

Practice report

Store appointment a1 for patient-a at 10:00 and a2 for patient-b at 11:00. Call reschedule("a1", "patient-a", "11:00").

Observation after the request Current starter Expected
Result "conflict" "conflict"
a1 time 11:00 10:00
a2 time 11:00 11:00

The rejection must preserve the complete schedule, including the patient's original slot and the other patient's appointment.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Only an appointment's owner may move it. Unknown appointments, a different patient, or an empty requested time return not_found without schedule changes.
  • A time occupied by another appointment returns conflict and leaves every appointment unchanged.
  • A successful move returns rescheduled, frees the old slot, and places the appointment in exactly one new slot.
  • Moving to the current slot succeeds without creating a duplicate.
  • If a patient has already moved successfully, a later rejected move preserves that current booking, not an earlier time.

Out of Scope

Use the supplied slot strings and in-memory repository. Calendar parsing, time zones, appointment duration, reminders, and clinical records are outside this ticket.

Investigation

Trace ownership, conflict handling, and persisted appointment state for the report. Add tests for a free slot, the current slot, a conflict, and a conflict after a successful move. Compare the full schedule before and after failures.
